summary.en: Oxford Science Enterprises (OSE) is the University of Oxford's preferred investor — an evergreen, patient-capital venture firm founded in 2015 with over £800m AUM. Uniquely, the university is a shareholder in OSE, which typically receives half the university's equity stake in spinouts. It has raised over £850m and, with 300+ co-investors, deployed over £2.5bn into 100+ Oxford spin-out companies in deep tech and life sciences.

In 2026 B4i and its B4i Fund SIS were folded — alongside Politecnico di Milano's PoliHub — into the ION/FSI-backed Tech Europe Foundation, a €100m (targeting €1bn by 2030) Milan deep-tech hub.

summary.en: The B4i Fund (B4i Fund SIS) is the venture vehicle of Bocconi for Innovation, Bocconi University's entrepreneurial hub and accelerator in Milan, established around 2020. It backs early-stage startups from the Bocconi ecosystem. In 2026, B4i and its fund were transferred — together with Politecnico di Milano's PoliHub — into the ION- and FSI-backed Tech Europe Foundation, a €100m Milan deep-tech hub targeting €1bn by 2030.
